data.one_liner: Parse and evaluate mathematical expressions in real, vector, and interval contexts.
data.what_it_does: A library for parsing strings into mathematical expressions, evaluating them with context models, simplifying them, and computing derivatives. It supports real numbers, vectors, and basic interval arithmetic.
use_when: You need to evaluate mathematical formulas entered as strings at runtime.
You need expression simplification or symbolic differentiation.
avoid_when: You need to parse complex numbers.
You need to work with N-dimensional vectors where N is greater than four.
strengths: Supports real numbers, vectors, and interval arithmetic.
Provides expression parsing, simplification, and differentiation.
Extensible through custom function definitions in code.
weaknesses: Parser only works for real numbers out of the box.
Some evaluations in vector and interval space (especially functions) are not working yet.
